name: anim_jyu_slide_dive
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: He takes a heavy step and throws himself forward head-first to the left, arms stretched out ahead, diving down and landing flat on his big belly on the ground with a wet splash of paint. The face keeps the same thick angular eyebrows, half-lidded eyes and closed mouth. Heavy, sticky, viscous paint.
